Black Rot.symptoms: Reddish-brown circular leaf spots with dark margins; berries shrivel into black "mummies"
Black Rot.response: Remove and destroy mummified berries, improve canopy airflow via leaf pulling, protectant fungicide during wet spring growth

Esca (Black Measles).symptoms: Interveinal "tiger-stripe" leaf streaking, dark berry spotting, occasional sudden vine collapse
Esca (Black Measles).response: No curative spray — preventive only: avoid pruning in wet weather, protect large cuts, remove severely affected vines

Leaf Blight (Isariopsis Leaf Spot).symptoms: Angular brown necrotic lesions, early defoliation
Leaf Blight (Isariopsis Leaf Spot).response: Sanitation (remove fallen leaves), improve airflow, protectant fungicide in humid periods

Healthy.response: No action — log for insights baseline

Apple Scab.symptoms: Olive-green to black velvety spots on leaves/fruit, fruit russeting
Apple Scab.response: Rake and destroy fallen leaves, protectant fungicide from green tip through early summer, resistant cultivars long-term

Black Rot (Frogeye Leaf Spot).symptoms: Purple-bordered "frogeye" leaf spots, fruit rot with concentric rings, branch cankers
Black Rot (Frogeye Leaf Spot).response: Prune out cankers and dead wood, remove mummified fruit, protectant fungicide

Cedar Apple Rust.symptoms: Bright orange-yellow leaf spots (needs a nearby juniper/cedar host)
Cedar Apple Rust.response: Remove nearby host junipers if feasible, protectant fungicide in spring, resistant cultivars long-term

Healthy.response: No action — log for insights baseline
